$comment: Recorded dispositions for this workspace's production dependency advisories.
The audit gate fails on any advisory that is not listed here, so a new one
has to be looked at rather than accumulating in a report nobody reads.
Every entry needs an owner and an expiresOn date. The gate fails once that
date passes, so an acceptance is a decision with an end rather than a
permanent exemption nobody revisits. Owners are roles, never people.
Empty on purpose. The three advisories this gate found on the day it was
added were fixed rather than accepted: Next 16.2.11 to 16.3.3 for two
critical unauthenticated remote-code-execution advisories, and the sharp
override from 0.35.0 to 0.35.4 for a high one in libheif. An empty list is
the better outcome, and it is not the same as no gate: the gate still runs,
and the next advisory stops it.
